title: A shared word needs actual confirmation

captions.energy: Removing a joint promise’s false foundation
captions.emotions: Feeling the value of accepted words

meaning: You can discover an answer given for both lacks a basis and remove a joint promise’s false foundation, preserving the value of words genuinely accepted by both.
text: The Tower in the physical position of your Vishuddha reveals an unsound answer presented as shared. The Tower in energy supports willingness to remove a promise’s false foundation and name what remains unconfirmed. The Hierophant in emotions brings significance to accepted words and respect for an understandable agreement. Visibly discovering an error differs from an inward readiness to reconsider the answer’s basis. Taking promises seriously allows their meaning to be corrected rather than defending a shared signature at any cost.

For example, an invitation receives “We agree”, although one of you has not yet seen the question. Discussion makes this explicit and the shared answer loses its foundation. **Taking words seriously allows an unconfirmed promise to be corrected**. You name which willingness was real and what still needs asking. Respect for agreement can remain without requiring somebody’s assumption to be fulfilled. Clarification does not make every joint answer unreliable: it separates what you accepted from what was named prematurely.

Difficulty arises if, after correction, every simple confirmation meets endless scrutiny of its right to be called shared. A word’s significance then turns into distrust of agreement itself. Constructive Tower energy helps remove a particular false foundation without destroying what was confirmed alongside it. You can clearly ask about present willingness and hear the answer; seriousness requires neither remaining unchanged after an error nor a complete guarantee against every future inaccuracy.
